identification: Edwardian two-door wardrobe, c1905-1915, Australian, honey/golden figured timber consistent with Tasmanian blackwood (catalogued blackwood; no reason to doubt from photos). Moulded cornice, two panelled doors each with arched bevelled mirror plate under carved acanthus/foliate crest, long single drawer with two pressed-brass Art Nouveau style handles on plinth base. Interior: one full-width shelf, hanging rail with hooks below cornice, plain pale timber back (Tas oak/hoop pine style boards). H 203 W 165 D 61 cm. Looks sound and clean, finish good. Armitage estimate A$100-200.
